cost_model.source: MADE UP for gameplay. engine_thrust_exponent: an engine run at a different thrust than its catalogue entry costs (thrust ratio)^0.7, in the spirit of real cost-estimating relationships, where cost grows with size to a power below 1. Fin, gimbal, tower and custom-engine costs are placeholders. budget_star_min_left_fraction: keep at least 10% of the budget unspent to earn the budget star (MADE UP). Moved here from builder_ui.json so the sim does not read UI config.
